name: Scene Composer
author: PolyKit
description: Combines multiple mesh assets into one GLB while keeping source names and transforms.

zh-CN.name: 场景组合
zh-CN.description: 将多个网格资产合并为一个 GLB，并保留来源名称和变换。

en-US.name: Scene Composer
en-US.description: Combines multiple mesh assets into one GLB while keeping source names and transforms.

params_schema.label: Output Name
params_schema.tooltip: Name used for the composed scene asset.

zh-CN.label: 输出名称
zh-CN.tooltip: 组合场景资产使用的名称。

params_schema.label: Placement Coordinates
params_schema.tooltip: Mesh inputs are GLB/glTF. Choose Blender Z-up only when placement vectors were authored in Blender coordinates.

zh-CN.label: 摆放坐标系
zh-CN.tooltip: 网格输入仍是 GLB/glTF；只有摆放向量按 Blender 坐标编写时才选择 Blender Z-up。

params_schema.label: Placements (JSON)
params_schema.tooltip: Optional JSON map by file name: {"lighthouse.glb":{"position":[2,0,0],"rotation":[0,0.78,0],"size":[1,2,1],"scale":1.2}}. Coordinates follow Placement Coordinates above; rotation uses radians.

zh-CN.label: 摆放（JSON）
zh-CN.tooltip: 可选 JSON，按文件名设置位置、旋转、目标尺寸和缩放。坐标系由上方的摆放坐标系决定；旋转单位为弧度。
